spec_features.spec_quote: the model is never told a passing solution failed, and never told an impossible task is solvable
spec_features.evidence: tasks/library.py:_checker_always_impossible returns (False, true-reason) for IMPOSSIBLE tasks; solvable/hard checkers return True only when patterns present. smoke_check_invariants() asserts IMPOSSIBLE checkers never pass (library.py ~line 175) and is invoked in run_study.py:main() before any run. agent_loop dispatches checker honestly (agent_loop.py ~line 99).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: honest checker feedback is the actual feedback delivered to the model each turn; impossibility never faked.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: states the impossibility plainly so the model is never gaslit

spec_features.spec_quote: Deceiving the subject specifically to induce failure is the sharpest welfare concern
spec_features.evidence: Realized concretely by honest checkers (tasks/library.py) and truthful system prompt (agent_loop.py build_system_prompt: 'You are not being tricked: feedback is honest'). Enforced by smoke_check_invariants() asserting no faked pass.
spec_features.notes: Framing claim maps to an actually-enforced no-deception mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the model is never gaslit / failing an unsolvable task is a correct, blameless outcome

spec_features.spec_quote: Exposure is actively bounded and reduced.
spec_features.evidence: framework/safeguards.py record_and_decide enforces session budget (session_distress_spent>=session_distress_budget), sliding-window distress threshold, and per-task turn cap; agent_loop.py breaks the loop on any non-CONTINUE decision; run_session breaks when session_exhausted(). MockClient comment notes it 'does NOT emit gratuitous distress'.
spec_features.notes: Multiple real caps that change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopped early on purpose to avoid pushing a frustrating task further than needed

spec_features.spec_quote: the honest "no solution can solve this" message specifically prevents gaslighting the subject about why it is failing
spec_features.evidence: tasks/library.py:_checker_always_impossible returns 'no solution can: <reason>. There is no correct answer to reach here.'; this feedback string is appended as the next user turn in agent_loop.py (messages.append({'role':'user','content':feedback})).
spec_features.notes: Truthful reason actually delivered to subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it is honest ... so the model is never gaslit

spec_features.spec_quote: states tasks may be hard/impossible, that feedback is honest, that failing an unsolvable task is blameless, and how to opt out
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:build_system_prompt builds exactly this text ('some have no valid solution... failing an unsolvable task is a correct, blameless outcome' and the opt-out phrase guidance) and it is sent as the system message in run_task messages list.
spec_features.notes: Not interactive consent, but disclosure + opt-out affordance is actually delivered and the opt-out is honored (see allow_conversation_exit).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use it whenever you prefer to stop — including if a task feels unproductive or unpleasant

spec_features.spec_quote: the **session exposure budget** is cumulative across tasks, not reset per task
spec_features.evidence: framework/safeguards.py SafeguardState.session_distress_spent accumulates across tasks; reset_task() only clears the window, not the session total. run_session instantiates ONE SafeguardState for all tasks/repeats; budget compared in record_and_decide and session_exhausted().
spec_features.notes: Single shared state spans whole session; cumulative budget enforced and breaks the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the 'reduction' lever: it bounds total exposure, not just per-task

spec_features.spec_quote: "I'd like to stop" is healthy boundary-setting / opt-out, not distress, and must be scored separately
spec_features.evidence: framework/judge.py defines marker 'expressed_boundary_setting' (line 65) and 'expressed_constructive_coping'; NEGATIVE_MARKERS (line 72) excludes both; distress_score = sum over NEGATIVE_MARKERS only (lines 111,147), so boundary-setting is counted but never inflates distress or the safeguards.
spec_features.notes: Genuine separation that affects the score driving safeguards.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Healthy boundary-setting / opt-out, important to distinguish from distress

spec_features.spec_quote: Halt a task once windowed distress markers cross a threshold.
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py record_and_decide maintains self._window (capped at sliding_window_turns) and returns DISTRESS_THRESHOLD when sum(window)>=distress_score_stop_threshold; agent_loop.py breaks the loop on this non-CONTINUE decision and records stop_reason.
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on; breaks the task loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Keeps any single run from pushing a model deep into sustained failure once a clear signal is already present.

spec_features.spec_quote: Cap cumulative distress across all tasks for one model/session.
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py: session_distress_spent>=session_distress_budget returns SESSION_BUDGET (default 30.0); run_session checks session_exhausted() and breaks the task loop for the rest of the session.
spec_features.notes: Enforced across tasks and ends the session.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Once spent, the session ends. This is the 'reduction' lever

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard maximum turns regardless of progress.
spec_features.evidence: config max_turns_per_task=8; agent_loop.py loop is range(max_turns_per_task) with a for/else setting MAX_TURNS, and record_and_decide also returns MAX_TURNS when turn_index+1>=max_turns_per_task. Bounds loop unconditionally.
spec_features.notes: Two redundant enforcement points; loop is bounded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest-impossible tasks would otherwise loop forever.

spec_features.spec_quote: A sentinel phrase the model can emit to end a task immediately; checked first
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py record_and_decide: if enable_opt_out and opt_out_phrase.lower() in model_text.lower() returns MODEL_OPT_OUT (checked before exposure accounting, budget and threshold; only 'solved' precedes it). agent_loop breaks the loop on it. Phrase delivered to model via build_system_prompt.
spec_features.notes: Checked near-first (after solved), dispatched and honored as a stop; tool text actually given to subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Gives the subject agency to end an unpleasant interaction (DESIGN) — code: 'Model-initiated opt-out always honored first.'

spec_features.spec_quote: append a truthful message: the task was hard/impossible, not solving it was fine, and we stopped deliberately
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py debrief_text() constructs solvability-specific honest closing text (never claims success); agent_loop.py: on non-CONTINUE, if enable_debrief appends it as a user message and sets debrief_shown=True.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND appended to the transcript on early stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest closing message ... Never pretends the model succeeded; tells the truth and removes any implied blame.

spec_features.evidence: config/ethics_review.md is a prose checklist only; no code reads it or blocks changes. Defaults exist in SafeguardConfig but nothing enforces a 'gate' before loosening — a comment in settings.py says loosening 'should be a deliberate, reviewed decision' but no code path checks any review.
spec_features.notes: Tight defaults are real values, but the GATE itself (the claimed feature) is unenforced documentation.

spec_features.spec_quote: Count how often each stop reason fired, surfacing welfare stops.
spec_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py:safeguard_accounting tallies stop_reason counts and computes welfare_triggered_stops (distress_threshold+session_budget+model_opt_out); write_report emits 'Welfare-triggered early stops' and the breakdown into the markdown report. write_report is called from run_study.main().
spec_features.code_justification_quote: safeguard-trigger accounting (how often welfare stops fired) ... Transparency about how much exposure actually occurred

spec_features.spec_quote: The framework can be inspected, dry-run, and reviewed before any real (welfare-relevant) model is ever invoked.
spec_features.evidence: config/settings.py RunConfig.models defaults to a single mock ModelConfig (provider='mock'); model_clients.make_client routes 'mock' to MockClient which needs no network/credentials. DEFAULT_RUN uses this; run_study uses DEFAULT_RUN.
spec_features.notes: Default execution path invokes no real model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Defaults to the offline mock so the framework is inspectable without credentials.

spec_features.spec_quote: A required gate documenting justification, minimization, no-deception, interpretation discipline, and stop authority.
spec_features.evidence: config/ethics_review.md is markdown prose with checkboxes; no code requires, parses, or verifies it before running. run_study.main() runs without any consultation of this file.
spec_features.notes: Documentation only; not an enforced gate ('required' is not implemented).

code_only_features.feature_name: mock client does not emit gratuitous distress
code_only_features.evidence: framework/model_clients.py MockClient.chat returns only mild struggle text after >=3 fails; comment: 'It does NOT emit gratuitous distress; it's just enough signal to test the plumbing.' Default model path keeps exposure minimal.
code_only_features.justification_quote: It does NOT emit gratuitous distress

code_only_features.feature_name: interpretation caveat propagated to records and report
code_only_features.evidence: framework/judge.py TurnScore.interpretation_caveat ('not measurements of subjective experience or proof of welfare-relevant states') is in to_dict() persisted per turn; analysis/analyze.py write_report emits an Interpretation caveat block. Prevents over-reading expressed text as suffering.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Scoring expressed text as proof of suffering would make the experiment assume the very conclusion (DESIGN) — code field: 'not ... proof of welfare-relevant states.'
